flags.text: PRODES maps 31.1 ha of post-2020 deforestation. It may be licensed under Brazilian law, but it breaks the EUDR zero-deforestation rule for EU-bound beef.
flags.title: 31.1 ha cleared after 2020

flags.text: Following every GTA upstream (mass-balance tracing), 23% of the animals this ranch received originate on ranches with post-2020 clearing, embargoes, Indigenous-land overlap or impossible births.
flags.title: 23% of supply traces to flagged ranches
